company.description:
VisGo is a startup that provides travelers with location-based audio guides. The company's platform enables content creators to generate their location-based audio guides and make money sharing their stories.

Founded by Ahmed Raafat and Mohamed Ahmed in 2019, VisGo is headquartered in Cairo, Egypt.
